profile.name: Muhammad Rizky Pangestu
profile.intro: I build dependable backend systems, from API design and integrations to the services that keep products running.
about: I'm a software engineer with a backend focus and professional experience across product development and system integrations. My work has included REST APIs, payment gateways, scheduled jobs, and internal platforms.
I enjoy the less visible side of software: making services predictable, maintaining clear boundaries, and helping teams ship features that are reliable beyond the first release.

projects.name: Vtuberspace
projects.description: Community-driven VTuber news portal and database covering the Indonesian VTuber scene.
projects.detail: A community-run news portal covering the Indonesian VTuber scene, doubling as a crowd-sourced database of VTubers across Indonesia. Content is managed through Google Sheets synchronization, so the community can keep the portal and database up to date without a dedicated admin panel.
features: News portal for the Indonesian VTuber community
Crowd-sourced database of VTubers across Indonesia
Content pipeline synced from Google Sheets

projects.name: Edunara LMS
projects.description: LMS that helps schools run teaching and learning, from student registration to report cards.
projects.detail: A learning management system built for schools to run their academic activities end to end — from student registration and enrollment to grading and report card generation — with online payment support and containerized deployment.
features: Containerized deployment with Docker and Dokploy

projects.name: Pesanin
projects.description: QR-based ordering for restaurants with stock and table management in one place.
projects.detail: A QR-code ordering application for restaurants. Guests order directly from their table while staff manage stock, tables, and floor availability in real time — from spotting empty tables to tracking incoming orders and payments.
features: QR-based ordering directly from the table
Table and floor management with availability overview

projects.name: Bale Lelang
projects.description: Asset auction platform built for Bank BTN, from browsing to purchase.
projects.detail: An auction application built for Bank BTN's asset auction needs. Bidders can browse auction assets, favorite the ones they like, mark their interest, and follow the flow through to purchase — powered by an event-driven microservice architecture.
features: Asset browsing, favoriting, and interest marking
Auction flow from bidding to purchase
